card.text: Explore Epimetheus with Cassini imagery, mapped radial height and its measured irregular shape.

introduction.text: Epimetheus shares an orbit with the larger moon Janus. The pair exchanges inner and outer tracks about every four years. Cassini revealed a battered icy surface, including a flattened south pole and branching ridges.

normal.title: ISS mosaic
normal.summary: Brightness matching reduces photographed shading. The gray grid marks missing coverage and terrain hidden in cast shadows.

elevation.title: Shape-derived radial height
elevation.summary: Height relative to a 58.2 km sphere, from the Cassini shape model. Small craters are unresolved.
